data_collection_notes.environment_limitation: This research ran in a sandboxed environment with outbound network restricted to a search proxy only. Direct HTTPS (curl), the Liveheats GraphQL API (https://liveheats.com/api/graphql), full-page fetches, and headless-browser (Playwright) rendering were all blocked (HTTP 403 / host-not-in-allowlist). Findings therefore come from web-search result pages and their summaries, not from full source-page rendering or the GraphQL API.
data_collection_notes.implication: Live ranking points, the Liveheats athlete profile, and heat-by-heat scores could not be pulled programmatically. The seed results were all corroborated where public coverage existed. Items that could not be verified are flagged rather than guessed.
